We present a single-cell atlas of 11. 7M cells from 48 donors and 18 tissues, integrating 3' scRNA-seq and CITE-seq
(184 proteins) via a scVI-Harmony hybrid latent space (z30). The model xng(_nng,θ_g) with _n=fθ(z_n,s_n) achieves kBET
acceptance 0. 94 and LISI 2. 1, correcting 142 batch lanes. Leiden clustering (γ=1. 2, k=30) yields 284 clusters
mapping to 187 reference types at 0. 92 precision.
